plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: bottle anchors the left edge, headline dominates the middle with legal tucked beneath it as a quiet footnote, and the right column stacks the logo over the orange CTA so brand and action sit together at the end of the read.

Brand-first sequence: the logo lockup opens the strip on the left, the headline (with legal underneath) carries the centre, then the bottle and CTA close on the right, so the eye goes brand to message to product to action.

Product-left lockup: the bottle on the left, a small logo sitting on top of a large headline as one brand-and-message block, and a right column with a tall CTA over the legal line, the usual 'button plus fine print' pairing.
